text:
emma: quick sync0 min. i created a compact service catalog view with ownership runway + downstream fanout metrics. link: https://redwood.internal/notes/catalog-runway :sparkles:
noah: nice. can you share the top 3 services where fanout is causing most deploy flakiness?
emma: pasted top-3:
- session-orchestrator: fanout 24, deploy-failures 12/mo, owner: infra-team
- enrich-fanout: fanout 18, deploy-failures 9/mo, owner: data-team
- model-proxy: fanout 15, deploy-failures 14/mo, owner: serving
ravi: model-proxy again. suggest interface-fence + consumer-level adapters. do the adapters live in consumer repos or as a shared sdk?
noah: prefer thin consumer adapters per team to avoid central churn. provide reference impl in mono-repo and publish sdk later.
ops-bot: created ticket ARCH-1209 and feature-flag `iface_fence_model_proxy`. runbook stub at #runbooks/iface-fence/1842009999.
emma: funding: propose 12% steady allocation + one 3-week "hardening sprint" per quarter for top-5 catalog items. keeps pressure without huge context switches.
ravi: agree. also add a mandatory contract-test that consumers run in CI against the fence. small snippet we can graft:
```
contract_test.assert_equivalence(legacy_resp, fenced_resp, threshold=0.01)
```
noah: add dashboards: adapter-migration-count, consumer_compat_fail_rate, and deploy_flake_rate. we'll review at next arch sync. planned RFC next Tue.
